sentences.translation: 一条饥饿的狼想把鸡养肥来做炖鸡，却产生了意想不到的结果。

sentences.sentence: New heat-resistant stewpot and tableware stand proudly without peer in this generation.
sentences.translation: 本厂新产品，耐高温炖盅餐具，堪称旷世无双。

sentences.sentence: Once the instru-ments are worn out, the musicians, and a conductor who doubles as cook, toss each onesintosa stewpot to make soup -- to be enjoyed by the audience after the concert.
sentences.translation: 这些乐器若是用坏了,乐手们和指挥(他还兼厨师)就把它们扔到锅里做汤,在音乐会之后让观众们享用。

sentences.sentence: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
sentences.translation: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

sentences.translation: 朱莉娅：在多伦多能玩些什么？

sentences.sentence: It is easier to tell where in England someone is from than it is to tell if someone is from Denver or Toronto.
sentences.translation: 可以说你想判断一个英国人来自英国的哪个城市都要比判断一个人到底是来自丹佛还是多伦多容易。

sentences.sentence: About 830 people on Facebook have replied they would attend the event in Toronto.
sentences.translation: 大约有830人在脸书上回覆称他们会参与这个多伦多的活动。

sentences.sentence: He was narrowly defeated in the election.
sentences.translation: 他在选举中以微弱差距败北。

sentences.sentence: One bullet struck his car, narrowly missing him.
sentences.translation: 一颗子弹击中了他的汽车，差点打中他。

sentences.sentence: A man narrowly escaped death when a fire broke out in his home on Sunday morning.
sentences.translation: 周日早晨一名男子家中起火，险些丧命。

sentences.translation: 我把她的熟练程度提高到所规定的水平。

sentences.sentence: With study and practice, almost anyone can do it with some level of proficiency, but most people don't learn how to think critically or analytically—nor are they even aware of its value.
sentences.translation: 通过学习和实践，几乎任何人都能以不同的熟练程度来掌握它，但是大多数人都不会去学习如何进行批判性或分析性思维，或者说，他们根本意识不到其价值。

sentences.sentence: How do you think of your proficiency in written and spoken English?
sentences.translation: 你认为你的书面 英语和 口语熟练程度如何？

sentences.sentence: Meanwhile, industry, civil society groups and governments continue to spar over the application of intellectual property rights to products and genetic sequences derived from natural resources.
sentences.translation: 其间，工业、民间社会团体以及政府持续对申请产品和得自自然资源的基因序列的知识产权问题产生争论。

sentences.sentence: Do you like your hometown?
sentences.translation: 你喜欢你的家乡吗？

sentences.sentence: She expressed the wish to be interred in the graveyard of hometown.
sentences.translation: 她表达了死后葬在故乡的墓地上的愿望。

sentences.translation: 从语言学、社会学的人类行为原理里解脱吧。

sentences.sentence: Basic courses in sociology and psychology as well as other humanities courses give students plenty of opportunity to explore their own emotions.
sentences.translation: 社会学和心理学的基础，以及其他人文学科的课程，赋予学生大量的机会去探索其个人情感。

sentences.sentence: And I spent part of my second grade year in Sweden, where my father was on sabbatical as a professor of sociology.
sentences.translation: 因为我父亲休假的缘故，我的小学二年级有一段时间是在瑞典上的，那个时候他是一名社会学教授。

sentences.translation: 在生面团中加一些葡萄干。

sentences.sentence: A baker is kneading a dough.
sentences.translation: 一位面包师正在揉面团。

sentences.sentence: She patted the dough into a flat cake.
sentences.translation: 她把面团轻轻拍成扁饼。

sentences.sentence: Jo has a flair for languages.
sentences.translation: 乔有语言天赋。

translations.translation: 秘传的,  神秘的,  难懂的

sentences.translation: …深奥难懂的知识。

sentences.sentence: ...a magic potion that will make Siegfried forget Brunnhilde and fall in love with Gutrune.
sentences.translation: …一种会使齐格弗里德忘掉布伦希德尔德而爱上古特鲁内娜的魔剂。

translations.translation: 炼金药, 不老长寿药

sentences.sentence: the search for the elixir of life
sentences.translation: 寻找长生不老药

translations.translation: 分不开地, 无法摆脱地

sentences.translation: 我们的生存与雨林的生存息息相关。

sentences.translation: 粗略的、不精确的估计

sentences.sentence: Alcohol affects the brain, making speech slurred and imprecise.
sentences.translation: 酒精影响大脑，使言语含糊不清。

sentences.sentence: The United States bestowed honorary citizenship upon England's World War II prime minister, Sir Winston Churchill.
sentences.translation: 美国授予了二战期间的英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔爵士荣誉公民的称号。

sentences.sentence: He’s always willing to help. Bless him!
sentences.translation: 他一向乐于助人，愿上帝保佑他！

sentences.sentence: ‘Jess made this card for me.’ ‘Bless!’
sentences.translation: “杰斯给我做了这张卡。”“真不错！”

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 92 单元

rattlesnake
音标：英 /'ræt(ə)lsneɪk/  美 /'rætlsnek/
n. <美>[动]响尾蛇
例句：The rattlesnake tissues provoked the strongest response of all the species in the study.
响尾蛇的组织在本次所有研究物种中所作出的反应最强烈。
例句：One family of completely harmless snakes, the kingsnake, has also evolved serum that neutralizes rattlesnake venom and uses that ability to greater advantage than ground squirrels do.
完全无毒蛇大家庭中的一种，王蛇，也进化出了能中和响尾蛇毒液的血清，并且靠着这一能力获得了比松鼠们更大的好处。

glamorous
音标：英 /'glæmərəs/  美 /'glæmərəs/
adj. 富有魅力的, 迷人的
例句：She led an exciting and glamorous life.
她生活奢华，充满刺激。
例句：the most glamorous neighborhood in the city
城里最繁华的街区
例句：On television, she looks so glamorous.
她在电视里看上去光彩照人。

brim
音标：英 /brɪm/  美 /brɪm/
n. (杯, 碗等)边, 边缘
v. 注满
短语：to the brim — 充满，满到边缘上
短语：brim with — 洋溢着；充满着
例句：Rain dripped from the brim of his baseball cap.
雨水从他的棒球帽檐上滴下来。

boot
音标：英 /buːt/  美 /but/
n. <美> (长统)靴
短语：boot loader — 引导装载程序
短语：boot camp — n. ［美口］海军训练新兵之营地
短语：boot sector — n. 引导扇区；启动磁区
短语：boot device — 启动设备；引导设备
短语：boot up — 启动
短语：boot record — 引导记录
短语：put the boot in — [主英国俚语]
短语：disk boot failure — 系统引导失败；磁盘自举失败
短语：boot menu — 启动菜单；引导菜单；开机选单
短语：rain boot — n. 雨鞋
短语：remote boot — 远程自举；远程引导
短语：get the boot — 解雇
短语：boots and all — [澳大利亚、新西兰口语]
短语：rubber boot — 胶靴；橡皮罩；橡胶套
例句：hiking boots
远足靴
例句：a pair of boots
一双靴子

garb
音标：英 /gɑːb/  美 /ɡɑrb/
n. 服装
v. 装扮
例句：priestly garb
牧师装束

flannel
音标：英 /'flæn(ə)l/  美 /'flænl/
n. 法兰绒(衣服)
短语：flannel shirt — 法兰绒衬衫；法兰绒上衣
例句：a flannel shirt
法兰绒衬衫

thigh
音标：英 /θaɪ/  美 /θaɪ/
n. 大腿, 股
短语：thigh bone — 股骨；腿节
例句：chicken thighs
鸡腿

collarless
音标：美 /'kɔləlis/
adj. 无领的,无马轭(或颈圈)的
例句：Originally the collarless shirt and trousers were nondescript, of flannel or wool.
起初无领的衬衫和长裤是没用固定特征的，或者是法兰绒的或者是羊毛的。
例句：A slender forty-nine-year-old with salt-and-pepper hair and a fixed expression, he wore a dark suit with a collarless striped shirt.
马沙49岁，身材修长，头发斑白，脸上的表情一成不变。 他穿一套深色西装，里面是一件无领子的条纹T恤。

cowhand
音标：英 /'koʊ,hænd/  美 /'kaʊhænd/
n. <美>(牧场的)牧牛工

taxonomy
音标：英 /tæk'sɒnəmɪ/  美 /tæk'sɑnəmi/
n. 分类法, 分类学
例句：However, some people consider glossary and taxonomy as metadata as well.
不过，有些人认为词汇表和分类法也属于元数据的范畴。
例句：This also grants read access to each taxonomy and category that you have read access to.
还授予对您已具有读访问权的每种分类法和类别的读访问权。
例句：This also grants read, edit, or delete access to each taxonomy and category that you have read, edit, or delete access to.
这还授予对您已具有读取、编辑或删除访问权的每种分类法和类别的读取、编辑或删除访问权。

narrower
adj. 有限的, 精密的
n. 海峡

waterfall
音标：英 /'wɔːtəfɔːl/  美 /'wɔtɚfɔl/
n. 瀑布, 瀑布似的东西
短语：waterfall model — 瀑布模型
短语：waterfall effect — 瀑布效应
例句：...Angel Falls, the world's highest waterfall.
…安赫尔瀑布，世界上最高的瀑布。

hibernation
n. 过冬, 冬眠, 避寒
例句：Heart rate tracking for three of the Alaska bears showed a drop from 55 beats per minute on average before hibernation to 14 erratic ones per minute in winter.
对三头阿拉斯加的黑熊的心率追踪显示出它们在冬眠前的平均每分钟 55 下降低到了冬天里每分钟飘忽不定的 14 下。

evenness
n. 平均, 平等, 平坦
短语：yarn evenness — 纱线均匀度

poikilotherm
n. [动]变温动物,冷血动物
例句：Fish are poikilotherm whose body temperature changes as the ambient water temperature changes.
鱼类是变温动物，其体温随环境的水温变化而变化。

unload
音标：英 /ʌn'ləʊd/  美 /'ʌn'lod/
v. 卸货
v. 摆脱之负担
例句：Unload everything from the boat and clean it thoroughly.
从小船上卸下所有的货物并彻底地清洗。

depositor
音标：英 /dɪ'pɒzɪtə/  美 /dɪ'pɑzɪtɚ/
n. 寄托者, 存款人
例句：Notice that the St. Louis memo tiptoes around the question of telling a depositor that he has a demand deposit while telling the rest of the country that he has a time deposit.
请注意，圣路易斯储备银行的备忘录一直在一个问题上遮遮掩掩，那就是把存款人的活期存款说成定期存款，欺骗国人。

lyrically
adv. 抒情地,  狂热地
例句：He lyrically described the countryside around his home.
他以抒情的笔调描绘了住宅周围的乡村景致。

theatrically
adv. 戏剧化地
例句：He theatrically turned his head to watch a butterfly flutter by.
他戏剧化的转头看飞过的蝴蝶。

splinter
音标：英 /'splɪntə/  美 /'splɪntɚ/
n. 尖片, 碎片
v. 分裂
例句：I’ve got a splinter in my finger.
我的手指扎了一根刺。

tonnage
音标：英 /'tʌnɪdʒ/  美 /'tʌnɪdʒ/
n. 登记吨位, 排水量
短语：gross tonnage — 总吨位
例句：A huge tonnage of bombs has already been dropped on the area.
巨大吨数的炸弹已被投到该地区。

seagoing
音标：英 /'siːgəʊɪŋ/  美 /'sɪ'goɪŋ/
adj. 适于远航的,出海的
例句：a seagoing ship
远洋轮

jacket
音标：英 /'dʒækɪt/  美 /'dʒækɪt/
n. 夹克,护封
v. 给穿夹克
短语：leather jacket — 皮夹克
短语：water jacket — 水套
短语：down jacket — 羽绒服；鸭绒衣；羽绒夹克
短语：life jacket — 救生衣
短语：cooling jacket — [机]冷却套管
短语：yellow jacket — n. 黄马褂；小黄蜂
短语：dust jacket — n. 书皮；包书纸
短语：heating jacket — 加热套
短语：dinner jacket — 晚礼服；无尾礼服；小礼服；礼服夹克（等于tuxedo）
短语：sports jacket — 猎装；便装上衣；（男子在非正式场合穿的）粗花呢西装外套
短语：waterproof jacket — 防水密外套；防水夹克
短语：cooling water jacket — 冷却水套
短语：cable jacket — 电缆外壳；电缆套管
例句：...a black leather jacket.
…一件黑色皮夹克。

fisherman
音标：英 /'fɪʃəmən/  美 /'fɪʃɚmən/
n. 渔民, 渔夫
例句：The Algarve is a paradise for fishermen whether river anglers or deep-sea fishermen.
阿尔加维对河边的垂钓者或深海的渔民都是一个天堂。

mainsheet
音标：英 /'meɪnʃiːt/  美 /'men,ʃit/
n. 主桅帆操纵索

oblivious
音标：英 /ə'blɪvɪəs/  美 /ə'blɪvɪəs/
adj. 没注意到, 健忘的
例句：She lay motionless where she was, oblivious to pain.
她一动不动地躺在原地，感觉不到疼痛。

coaming
音标：英 /'kəʊmɪŋ/  美 /'komɪŋ/
n. 舱口栏板, 边材
例句：The acetic acid is corrosive. Please put them in both sides of No. 5 deck, leaving a passage between the hatch coaming and the cargo.
醋酸（乙酸）有腐蚀性，请把其装在五舱甲板两边，在货物和舱口围板间留一条通道。
例句：The frame number marks, made of steel plate shall be welded and painted on the hatch coaming and bulwark at the place of every 10 frame-space and at every bulkhead.
每隔10档肋位和每一舱壁处要用钢板割的肋位标记焊接到舱口围和舷墙上。

lad
音标：英 /læd/  美 /læd/
n. 少年, 青年男子
例句：a young lad
小伙子
例句：Things were different when I was a lad.
我年轻的时候，情况可不大相同。

tilt
音标：英 /tɪlt/  美 /tɪlt/
v. (使)倾斜, 以言词或文字抨击
短语：tilt angle — 倾斜角
短语：tilt table — 倾斜台；摆动升降台
短语：at full tilt — 全速地；全力以赴地
例句：My mother tilted her head and smiled.
我妈妈歪着头笑了。
例句：Ned’s mouth tilted upwards slightly at the corners.
内德的嘴角微微翘起。

choppy
音标：英 /'tʃɒpɪ/  美 /'tʃɑpi/
adj. （海等）波浪起伏的, (指风)不断改变方向的
例句：The small boat bobbed about on the choppy water.
小船在波浪起伏的水面上颠簸。

illustrator
音标：英 /'ɪləstreɪtə/  美 /'ɪləstretɚ/
n. 插图画家,说明者
例句：Called up for military service, Mr. Marokvia spent the war as an illustrator for the Wehrmacht, applying brush and pencil in Ukraine, Italy, Finland and Yugoslavia.
玛洛克维亚先生被征召入伍，他作为一名德国国防军的插图画家，在乌克兰、意大利、芬兰和南斯拉夫留下了自己的墨迹。

ectothermic
n. 变温动物
例句：Determination of death in ectothermic animals may be more difficult due to differences in their physiology.
断定因安乐死死亡的动物可能更为困难因为不同的动物有不同的生理情况。

poikilothermic
adj. [动]变温的, 冷血动物的
例句：Unlike most terrestrial animals, aquatic animal species used for human consumption are poikilothermic, meaning their body temperatures vary according to ambient temperatures.
与大多数陆地动物不同，供人类消费的水生动物为冷血品种，也就是说它们的体温会根据环境温度而变化。
例句：These indeed have new comparative features in terms of the tolerance, comparing with the organisms that do not need to maintain homeostasis, such as poikilothermic organisms.
这与那些不需要保持内稳态的生物如变温生物相比，的确在耐受性方面存在新的比较特点。
例句：Amphibians and reptiles are poikilothermic and quite sensitive to the change of ambient temperature. They adapt to environmental temperature by means of self- thermoregulation .
两栖类和爬行类属于变温脊椎动物，它对外界环境温度的变化非常敏感，借助自身体温调节以适应或抵抗这种变化。

locomote
v. 移动, 行动
例句：Since plants cannot locomote , the sensation of experiencing pain would be superfluous. Thus, plants differ completely physiologically from mammals.
由于植物无法移动，它们不太需要具备感知痛苦的能力，因此，植物与哺乳动物在生理上全然不同。
例句：In simulation, millions of robotic modules assemble to form a large cube robot able to locomote in many types of environments.
在仿真方面，数以千计的机器人模块编译成一个可以在多种环境中移动的机器人。

inadequately
adv. 不够地,  不够好

onetime
adj. 从前的,  一度的
adv. 从前
例句：The onetime heir apparent had played an instrumental role this year in propping up his father's rule and his crackdown against the rebellion that ultimately ended his 42-year grip on power.
曾一度作为卡扎菲继承人的赛义夫今年在巩固其父亲的统治并帮助镇压反抗武装一事中起到积极作用。 这场反抗活动最终结束了卡扎菲对利比亚42年的统治。

citation
音标：英 /saɪ'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /saɪ'teʃən/
n. 引用,表扬
短语：citation index — 引文索引；引证索引
短语：science citation index — 科学文献索引
例句：...a 50-minute manifesto with citations from the Koran.
…一段长达50分钟、带有《古兰经》引文的宣言。

stillness
音标：英 /'stɪlnɪs/  美 /'stɪlnəs/
n. 静止, 沉静
例句：This is your true nature, one of effortless peace and stillness.
这就是你的本质，一个完全不需费力的平静和静止。
例句：As it is, I enjoy with something of sadness remembering that this melodious silence is but the prelude of that deeper stillness which waits to enfold us all.
实际上，我带着几分悲伤喜欢回忆起这种悦耳的沉默只是比较深层的寂静的前奏，它等待着要把我们所有的人笼罩起来。

eyesight
音标：英 /'aɪsaɪt/  美 /'aɪsaɪt/
n. 视力, 目力
短语：poor eyesight — 视力很差；视力差
例句：He had a problem with his eyesight.
他的视力有问题。

comical
音标：英 /'kɒmɪk(ə)l/  美 /'kɑmɪkl/
adj. 好笑的, 滑稽的
例句：The note of pure panic in his voice was almost comical.
他那种十分慌张的口气几乎有点滑稽。
